Major '''Cadmael Benthos Dosk''' was a military officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was assigned a key part of retrieving the [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]. He came into conflict with [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Wen Gallo|Gallo]] and the [[Alliance Commander]], attempting to kill both of then. His plans were eventually foiled and he was killed by the Commander and [[Arn Peralun]].<ref name="TOR" />
